title: TrueQuery project config (the tq-config block in DATA.md)
description: The YAML in DATA.md's ```tq-config fence. Unknown keys are allowed and ignored; the keys below are checked when TrueQuery reads them.

stack.description: Detected stack, such as plain, dbt or sqlmesh.

dialect.description: sqlglot dialect for SQL in this project; null means auto.

modes.description: Path globs and the mode each one is in.

rules.description: Per-rule settings. Human-only: agents never change these.

interrupt_edits.description: Whether per-edit findings go back to the agent. Human-only.

tier_overrides.description: Testing only: move a rule between the per-edit and end-of-turn checks. Human-only.

bases.description: Named base folders that path columns are relative to (`relative_to` in contracts).

setup.description: The project's answer for each optional part, so nobody is asked twice. Written by `truequery setup <part> --yes` (true) or `--no` (false).

data.description: The data reader (DuckDB) for `truequery verify`: true = wanted, false = the team said no.
